## Goal
Provide build guidance via breakpoints, target thresholds, and scoring.

## Tasks
- [ ] Add speed breakpoint utility and per-unit next-threshold gap.
- [ ] Add `data/targets.json` with minimum and ideal per-character stats.
- [ ] Show current vs minimum vs ideal targets in the UI.
- [ ] Add per-character substat weights.
- [ ] Compute and display relic score.
- [ ] Add recommended main stats by slot.
- [ ] Flag main-stat mismatch warnings.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Breakpoint gap updates when speed changes.
- [ ] Missing target data fails gracefully.
- [ ] Scoring is deterministic.
- [ ] Mismatch warnings are clearly visible.
